explication: This repository packages Claude Code skills, rather than a conventional application. The main workflow is RPI: a user invokes the skill with a change request, chooses a research/design/planning route or implementation, and works through task artifacts toward code changes. The other skills provide independent tasks for repository analysis, documentation, PR communication, and agent-workflow design. README documents the skill capabilities and invocation patterns; the detailed internal phase links below are limited to those documented there, not inferred from unsampled instructions.
